ontology.note: Existing ontology alignment; full configuration and port shape contracts remain to be defined. Emits is empty because the terms this widget's provenance asserts are written by src/raster-provenance.ts, while implementation.definition names src/core.ts#TYPES; the release declares what the defining module asserts, which is nothing of its own.

changes.description: A window past what a tab holds (166.4 million cells or 1.1 GB, lowered from 518.9 million) is streamed, not refused, by file or by address; a window saved before keeps reading. A streamed file is chosen again from the run's stop message and, in Chrome and Edge, remembered across sessions. Configure… always opens, even where the kept bytes cannot be read. The Inspector moves out of app.ts.

evidence.note: Repository regression coverage exists; this release entry does not certify a widget independently. 0.6.0: tests/raster-point-registration.test.mjs checks a point grid read as cells around its nodes, and a window keeping each value at its node; EGM2008 read from cdn.proj.org at the Manila gauge gives 43.009 m bilinearly, PROJ's value. 0.7.1: tests/country-from-study-area.browser.mjs checks the Inspector asks no country, and Configure… offers WorldPop for Botswana from the area, or says to set the country on the area; Chromium. 0.7.2: tests/country-from-study-area.browser.mjs chooses Botswana in the dialog, finds the download link, and finds the country kept on the study area; Chromium. 0.8.0: tests/area-countries.browser.mjs (two countries offered, the one-file limit said, the area's list left as it was). 0.9.0: tests/grid3-catalogue.test.mjs and tests/country-from-study-area.browser.mjs (GRID3 for Botswana, 11.6 MB; none for Germany). 0.10.0: tests/ghs-pop.browser.mjs (twelve years offered, the 2015 window read by range only, from a stand-in for JRC's server). The file's layout was measured from one 16 KB read of its header, 2026-11-11. 0.11.0: tests/worldpop-catalogue.test.mjs (sixteen Global2 years for Rwanda, the address as WorldPop publishes it, no link for a folder without a 100 m total) and tests/country-from-study-area.browser.mjs (both releases offered, the year kept across them); the 23 raster browser tests on the standard dialog; Chromium. 0.11.1: tests/raster.test.mjs (the window cut to the raster, the overhang said, no overlap refused; a 16.8 MB window validated and round-tripped through an encrypted workflow) and tests/stored-in-parts.browser.mjs (a 150 MB file stored in parts and read back whole); Botswana whole measured outside the application's dialogs, 2026-11-12, Chromium. 0.11.2: tests/worldpop-catalogue.test.mjs (Botswana 2025, Global2: units, year, title, URL; another name not guessed at); Chromium not run for this path. 0.12.0: tests/raster-reread.browser.mjs (exported without its bytes; a different file refused; the same read again and run, 968); tests/population-models-from-scratch.browser.mjs (Rwanda and Botswana, three sources each, GHS-POP read by range); tests/population-example-opens.browser.mjs (the pinned example's windows read again and checked, then run); tests/worldpop-catalogue.test.mjs; Chromium. 0.12.1: tests/sha256-stream.test.mjs (equal to SHA-256 at every block edge, fed unevenly, and read from a Blob); the practitioner's 12 GB file by hand in Chromium: kept in 68 s, digest equal to shasum's, the page drawing frames throughout. 0.12.2: tests/raster.test.mjs (a window of 1,483 rows read in bands gives every cell a whole read gives, the rows reported only rising, ending at 1,483 of 1,483); Chromium. 0.12.3: tests/geotiff-picture.test.mjs: three 8-bit bands or a palette are a picture, one band of numbers values. 0.13.0: tests/raster-stream.test.mjs (the blocks equal their cells' sums and means, terrio reading a GeoTIFF); the raster browser tests (75 passed, Chromium). Not measured on DR Congo.
